svg.title: Vert le Chemin (2025)
svg.desc: Vert le Chemin: Android app estimating the CO2 of daily trips.
svg.text: Android app that estimates the CO2 of a daily trip and compares it with everyday
consumption, to encourage a less polluting means of transport.
Specification, low-fi and high-fi mock-ups, and a Kotlin prototype up to the arrival
